note: Canonical note for a story arc or plot thread. A plotline groups the scenes that advance a single narrative question; scenes link to it via their `plotlines` field.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Fixed classifier — always `plotline`. Set by the template; do not change it.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Text. The plotline's canonical short name — used in `[[wikilinks]]` from scene notes. Should match the note title.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Text. A longer display title for the plotline (e.g. "The Heir's Hidden Past"). Distinct from `name`, which is the wikilink handle.

fields.name: logline
fields.description: Text. A one-sentence summary of the arc's dramatic question and stakes.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Select — one of `seed | active | resolved | abandoned`. Current development state of the plotline: `seed` = idea only, `active` = being written, `resolved` = narrative question answered, `abandoned` = cut from the story.

fields.name: series
fields.description: Text. The series this plotline belongs to.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: List. Always includes `planning/plotline` — how views and Bases select plotline notes.
